title: v5.6 gate. CTRL with seasonal-wildlife enabled and a roster applied the way a first run does (matrix assignment; cougar, dingo, wolf and the small prey allowed in every season), resident groups and migratory coupling on with packs of five, ecology on versus off. No harness manipulation of the pool or the units: the tool does everything. Sixty thousand ticks. Ecology on should kill prey beside the coupled predators (E11c: 19 of 19 with the relation written, 0 of 14 without); ecology off should look like E11c's no-lever arm.
fork: Does the shipped v5.6 do what the rig's lever did: relation written on the cadence, departed slots cleared, predators nudged to prey.

predictions.expects: ecology on: at least one wild prey death within the run in 3 of 3; ecology off: 0 of 3 (predator-on-predator deaths do not count)
ecology on kills no prey, or the groups status shows 0 pairs written or a Lua error

kill_criterion: prey deaths in the on arm and none in the off arm ships v5.6; anything else does not
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: ecology_on
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1 end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); for _,t in ipairs({'COUGAR','DINGO','WOLF','BIRD_EMU','BADGER','WOMBAT','PORCUPINE','KANGAROO','GROUNDHOG','SKUNK'}) do cfg.assign[t]={0,1,2,3}; cfg.allow[t]=true end; cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=true; cfg.groups.pack=5; cfg.ecology.enabled=true; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('roster: allowed %d assigned %d thin %d applied %d; predators and prey in every season; groups on, coupling on, pack 5, ecology %s; rotation enabled'):format(n,a,f,act, tostring(true)))

arms.name: ecology_off
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1 end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); for _,t in ipairs({'COUGAR','DINGO','WOLF','BIRD_EMU','BADGER','WOMBAT','PORCUPINE','KANGAROO','GROUNDHOG','SKUNK'}) do cfg.assign[t]={0,1,2,3}; cfg.allow[t]=true end; cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=true; cfg.groups.pack=5; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('roster: allowed %d assigned %d thin %d applied %d; predators and prey in every season; groups on, coupling on, pack 5, ecology %s; rotation enabled'):format(n,a,f,act, tostring(false)))
